collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: An elder listens to the wind in the palms, still unsure after a lifetime whether there are spirits in the trees.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (name1) has lived a long time on Isola, and there is one thing (he/she) has never been able to decide. When (he/she) was a child, (he/she) was sure there were spirits in the trees. When (he/she) was young, (he/she) was sure there weren't. In the middle years (he/she) changed (his/her) mind about once a season. Now, sitting outside (his/her) hut in the evening, listening to the wind in the leaves, (he/she) still doesn't know. Some villagers are certain one way. Some are certain the other. (name1) has stopped expecting to be certain. Tonight the wind makes a sound in the palms like a long, slow breath, and (name1) listens to it, and says quietly, "Goodnight," just in case. Then (he/she) goes inside. (He/she) has been not sure for most of (his/her) life, and it has turned out to be a perfectly comfortable place to live.
